### Label

podocytopathy

### Synonyms

_No response_

### Synonym type

None

### Definition

A group of glomerular diseases caused by the structural or functional impairment of podocytes which drive proteinuria or nephrotic syndrome. PMID:32792490, PMID:25684864, PMID:38804512

### Parent term

MONDO:0019722 glomerular disorder

### Children term(s)

MONDO:0006835 lipoid nephrosis, MONDO:0100313 focal segmental glomerulosclerosis
